zh.title: 会话恢复、桌面稳定性与网络修复
highlights: 会话历史改为执行前持久化，补齐崩溃后的历史抢救与恢复前缀；桌面反复启动崩溃可进入安全模式。
修复阅读滚动被锚点回拉、折叠工作组高度估值错位及代理绕过边界；更新下载按 URL 选择路线并避免重复直连。
MiniMax 默认模型升级为 M3.1 Flash，提供 1M 上下文与图片、视频输入，并区分全球和国内端点。

en.title: Session recovery, desktop stability, and network fixes
highlights: Session history is now persisted before execution, with crash rescue and recovery-prefix preservation; repeated desktop startup crashes can enter safe mode.
Fixed reading-position pullbacks, collapsed work-group size estimates, and proxy-bypass edge cases; updates now route per URL without duplicate direct attempts.
MiniMax now defaults to M3.1 Flash with a 1M context window and image/video input, with separate global and China endpoints.
